rules.name: grasa-barrier-replay-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT h.security_id, h.value_date, h.settle_price, h.settle_delta_1, h.settle_gamma_11, h.settle_vega_1, h.settle_theta FROM dbsystemuat.historical_security_settlement_value_table_cfs h WHERE h.value_date = :cob AND h.security_id IN ( SELECT security_id FROM dbsystemuat.helper_sensitivity_report_view_cache_table_cfs WHERE (SUBSTRING(contract_number, 1, 3) = 'ACM' AND product_code = 'CM CT') OR (SUBSTRING(contract_number, 1, 3) = 'IOL' AND product_code = 'CM BO') OR (SUBSTRING(contract_number, 1, 3) = 'PGE' AND product_code = 'CM S'))

WITH vd AS (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1), sec AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT DISTINCT upper(substring(c.contract_number, 1, 3)) AS client, upper(trim(c.product_code)) AS product, c.security_id FROM opera.helper_sensitivity_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM vd) AND upper(trim(c.business_unit)) = :bu AND ((upper(substring(c.contract_number, 1, 3)) = 'ACM' AND upper(trim(c.product_code)) = 'CM CT') OR (upper(substring(c.contract_number, 1, 3)) = 'IOL' AND upper(trim(c.product_code)) = 'CM BO') OR (upper(substring(c.contract_number, 1, 3)) = 'PGE' AND upper(trim(c.product_code)) = 'CM S')) ), base AS ( SELECT sec.client, sec.product, si.security_id, si.derivative_type, si.maturity_date AS maturity, si.strike, si.strike1, si.vol1_id, upper(cpm.call_put_id) AS cp, u1.settle_value AS f, u1.risk_free_rate AS rf, u1.div_yield AS div_yield, pm.tick_size, si.barrier1_level, si.barrier1_rebate, bm.isbarrier1_breached AS breached, CASE WHEN cv.p1_vol > 0 THEN cv.p1_vol WHEN shared_cv.p1_vol > 0 THEN shared_cv.p1_vol END AS overlay_vol FROM sec JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table si ON si.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM vd) AND upper(si.business_unit) = :bu AND si.security_id = sec.security_id LEFT JOIN opera.underlying_settle_value_table u1 ON u1.tenant_id = si.tenant_id AND u1.underlying_id = si.underlying1_id AND u1.value_date = :cob LEFT JOIN opera.derivative_type_call_put_id_mapping_table cpm ON upper(cpm.derivative_type) = upper(si.derivative_type) LEFT JOIN opera.underlying_list_table ul ON ul.tenant_id = si.tenant_id AND ul.underlying_id = si.underlying1_id LEFT JOIN opera.product_master_table pm ON pm.tenant_id = si.tenant_id AND pm.invenio_product_code = ul.invenio_product_code LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT max(b.isbarrier1_breached) AS isbarrier1_breached FROM opera.barrier_monitoring_table b WHERE b.tenant_id = si.tenant_id AND b.business_unit = si.business_unit AND b.security_id = si.security_id AND b.value_date <= :cob) bm ON true LEFT JOIN opera.calculated_settle_vol_table cv ON cv.tenant_id = si.tenant_id AND upper(cv.business_unit) = :bu AND cv.security_id = si.security_id LEFT JOIN opera.calculated_settle_vol_table shared_cv ON shared_cv.tenant_id IS NULL AND upper(shared_cv.business_unit) = :bu AND shared_cv.security_id = si.security_id WHERE si.derivative_type ILIKE 'vanilla%' OR si.derivative_type ILIKE 'amer%' ), v AS ( SELECT b.*, lo.strike AS lo_k, lo.settle_vol AS lo_v, hi.strike AS hi_k, hi.settle_vol AS hi_v FROM base b LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT s.strike, s.settle_vol FROM opera.settlement_vol_surf_table s WHERE s.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM vd) AND s.vol_id = b.vol1_id AND s.value_date = :cob AND upper(s.call_put_id) = b.cp AND s.strike <= b.strike1 ORDER BY s.strike DESC LIMIT 1) lo ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT s.strike, s.settle_vol FROM opera.settlement_vol_surf_table s WHERE s.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM vd) AND s.vol_id = b.vol1_id AND s.value_date = :cob AND upper(s.call_put_id) = b.cp AND s.strike >= b.strike1 ORDER BY s.strike ASC LIMIT 1) hi ON true ) SELECT client, product, security_id, derivative_type, maturity, strike, strike1, f, rf, div_yield, tick_size, barrier1_level, barrier1_rebate, breached, overlay_vol, CASE WHEN lo_k = strike1 THEN lo_v END AS surface_exact_vol, CASE WHEN lo_k = strike1 THEN lo_v WHEN lo_k IS NULL THEN hi_v WHEN hi_k IS NULL THEN lo_v ELSE lo_v + (hi_v - lo_v) * (strike1 - lo_k) / NULLIF(hi_k - lo_k, 0) END AS surface_interp_vol FROM v
